original: finished = operator.gt if inclusive else operator.ge
replacement: finished = operator.ge if inclusive else operator.ge
rationale: inclusive daterange drops the stop date
month stepping is off by one month

original: finished = operator.lt if inclusive else operator.le
replacement: finished = operator.le if inclusive else operator.le
rationale: descending inclusive daterange drops the stop date
fractional seconds are not right-padded to microseconds
DST boundary lands one day after the first Sunday
